decisions.reason: The cutting and creasing finisher sits close to the core Multigraf distributor line, has its own product page, and costs little to keep, so there is no reason to withdraw it.

The public German premiere and the flagship positioning in embellishment create strong visible commitment, and slow uptake in a new field can still be attributed to the market ramp-up, so management persists.
The B2 multifinisher was announced on the home page as the firm's new flagship solution and is central to its automated finishing direction, so the commitment strongly favors keeping it.
The hybrid saddle stitcher is core booklet-making equipment with its own page and fits the firm's portfolio naturally.
The folding add-on has a documented customer installation combined with the core creasing system, which justifies continued investment.
